Even when she visits New York on her royal duties, all she can do is smile elegantly and adhere to her strict schedule. As a 20-year-old young woman, she tires of her restrictive life, but with the help of a friend, she manages to escape for a few days. Walking through this exciting city, eating junk food and falling in love...all for the first time. But the clock keeps ticking and her time will soon run out!

(Source: Harlequin / SB Creative)

title.native: 王女様とボディガード

71913.description: A girl who, despite her boyish appearance, is secretly in love with ballet dancing...

71923.description:
A collection of stories.

1. Iijima-san no XXX (Iijima-san's XXX)
Sequel to Ikenai Otoko.

2. Himitsu no Library (Library of Secrets)
Sequel to Rumble Rush.
Iijima, everyone's favorite loser in love, is back and the flames of his desire are lit when he stumbles upon a hidden treasure - Misono, a tsundere librarian. Will Iijima finally succeed where he has failed so many times or will his attempts be for naught all over again? There's only one way to find out!
(Source: Blissful Sin)

3. Himitsu no Kyuugoshitsu

4. Hataraku☆Oniisan ~Toshiki-sensei no Baai~

5. Hataraku☆Oniisan ~Schuh Mameister - Kutsu Shokunin no Baai~

6. Hataraku☆Oniisan ~THE Shokunin~

7. Hataraku☆Oniisan ~Kikenna Yuuwaku - Ikenai Aji wo Oboeru~

8. Iijima-san no XXX Ver.2 (Iijima-san's XXX Ver.2)

71925.description:
A contest to determine the most unfortunate person on Earth is underway?! A hybrid school fantasy action thriller from Jung Pil-won, the author of "Family Man"!

(Source: Naver, translated)

71929.description:
This book contains a complete analysis of Type A, Type B, Type 0, Type AB boys in particular!!

1. How to love a B blood type boyfriend
It is said that blood type A and B are the worst combinations among all... What will happen to Kanade, a blood type A, and her blood type B boyfriend…!?

2. How to catch an A blood type guy
Miku, blood type 0, confesses to her love, blood type A, and was rejected. Being a blood type 0, she won't give up that easily, together she and her friends start devising plans to catch her love. Will their plans work?

3. The true character of an 0 blood type guy
Aki is a volleyball player in the springtime of her life who is uninterested in love. What will happen when she is confessed to a junior? What is he truly after?

4. Countermeasure your inclination to an AB blood type guy
Rio dislikes blood type AB guys after her unpleasant experiences with type AB boyfriends. And her fellow co-worker just happens to be a type AB. What will happen between the both of them?

5. The best boyfriend
After confessing to Murakami, a cool and intellectual student council president, Noa and Murakami started going out. However Noa starts to doubt if Murakami truly loves her or is he just too kind to reject her?

6. Your body temperature when you fall in love
No one can ever guess the relationship between Koga, a popular guy in school, and Ako, a lonewolf!

71943.description: After being instantly rejected by her crush, Takatsuki Yoshino gets seen by her absent-minded classmate, Sakura. Seeing how she seemed sad, Sakura decides to show her some magic tricks to cheer her up. Soon, Yoshino starts to talk more often with him and the two of them get closer... until Yoshino gets a bit... jealous?

title.native: わたしのまほう使いさま

71949.description:
A Kiss Note is a powerful notebook that makes anyone who has their name written together will instantly fall in love if they kiss each other regardless of any circumstances. This magical and very familiar item belongs to an angel named Guri whose job as cupid is to create couples. However, she accidentally writes down Aino Seiji, a regular high school student, and unless he kisses someone, Guri will die. She convinces Seiji to go kiss his crush, Hiyama Akane, the school’s popular girl who turns out has even stronger feelings for him, bordering on obsessive and psychotic. Eventually Akane and Seiji come together but not before Guri decides that she likes Seiji as well. What seems awesome to most guys becomes hell for Seiji who just wants a normal relationship with girls.

Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.
synonyms: The Very Lovely Tyrant of Love

71957.description: The story takes place in approximately the year 3000, when humankind arrived at the peak of its civilization, but is losing it's will to keep living. It follows a girl, called "princess" by those around her, living on a small island with a fifty person colony and a shinning coral reef. She is descendant of Moon people, and it focuses upon how her ancestor supposedly came to Earth.

71959.description: Can Shinomiya and Sunohara resolve their differences, admit their feelings, while harboring secrets?

71961.description:
To escape from a loan shark hunting him down, 23-year-old Heo Se runs straight into a mysterious and luxurious public bathhouse. After a strange twist of fate, he ends up working as a massage scrubber and has to fight to be the last scrubber standing. Let the battle to become the best scrubber... begin!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

71963.description:
Uchida's never ever been in love. He doesn't know what it's like to be restless and uneasy, to have his body heat up like it's on fire, to feel that tight pain in his chest. And then he meets Takahashi, and everything changes.

(Source: Vices and Devices)

title.english: Infused with a Lethal Dose of Love
title.native: 致死量分の愛を込めて

71973.description: Three boys in junior-high who cross-dress because of differing reasons meet each other through a cross-dressing community website, and decide to meet up in real life. "Parou" started cross-dressing because the boy he liked refused to date him unless he dressed up as a girl. "Marika" is transgender and identifies as female. Lastly, "Yui" is an antagonistic boy who adopted the persona of his older sister after her death. In contrast to Parou and Marika, Yui is sorely disappointed at the meeting.

71987.description:
Minako entered in the same high school as her friend Shuu. And then she figured out that one of her classmate is the guy she loves: Takuma. She will have to make a choice between love and friendship.

(Source: Chibi Manga)

Notes:
- Chapter count includes two extra chapters.
- Includes the two-part one-shot Sakura no Kioku (さくらの記憶).

71993.description:
High-school senior Nana seeks to photograph a whale in dedication to her dead boyfriend.

Note: Published in Hana to Yume 2009-10
synonyms: The Day I Kissed a Whale

71997.description: Manga adaptation to the Crusher Joe series illustrated by Fujihiko Hosono.
